capabilities: Sync vault notes across devices via a self-hosted Qdrant collection
Embed every note with a llama.cpp-compatible embedding server
Query the collection as a semantic search index from outside Obsidian
Pull changes from Qdrant with a command on new devices
extras: Conflict handling is last-write-wins by modification time only; the README warns it is not built for real-time collaborative editing and requires pre-creating a Qdrant collection sized to the embedding model.
intentEvidence: instead of Obsidian Sync, iCloud, or a CouchDB setup
problem: Obsidian Sync is a paid service and other self-hosted setups like CouchDB or Syncthing don't give you a semantic search index, so users need sync and embeddings in one self-hosted place.

relations.evidence: instead of Obsidian Sync, iCloud, or a CouchDB setup
Obsidian Sync, CouchDB, Syncthing - none of that is needed
This plugin talks to Qdrant directly over HTTP or HTTPS from inside Obsidian
An embedding server that speaks the llama.cpp /embedding endpoint

requires.name: Qdrant instance and a llama.cpp-compatible embedding server

summary: Syncs the vault across devices through a self-hosted Qdrant vector database and embeds every note for semantic search from outside tools.
